title: 145. 7 Steps for Getting Better Sleep feat. Nicole Shallow
description_html:
Today's guest is Nicole Shallow— a sleep expert, behavior coach, and public speaker who works to help others develop habits that ultimately improve their overall quality of life. In this episode, we discuss signs that you might be struggling to get good sleep, why teenagers often struggle most with getting good sleep, an ideal sleep schedule for teens and how teens can begin to try out this schedule, why getting good sleep is so important for your mental health, what to do during the day to get better sleep at night and the optimal nighttime routine for good sleep, and popular sleep myths debunked.  

Nicole's Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/yourbehaviourgal/

guests: nicole shallow, sleep expert and behavior coach
summary: sadie and nicole shallow discuss the relationship between sleep and mental health, with a focus on teens. they cover why adolescents struggle with sleep (circadian rhythm shifts, early school start times), signs of poor sleep, and how lack of rest affects emotional regulation, problem-solving, and stress management. nicole explains that sleep is like "a dishwasher for our brain" and shares practical steps: getting morning daylight, timing caffeine and meals, creating a wind-down routine with dim lights, limiting screens an hour before bed, and finding what brings you joy during the day. she emphasizes quality over quantity and suggests practicing rest outside of bedtime to reduce pressure.
quote: it's easier to be harder on yourself when you're not sleeping.
